semiconductor_relevance: High — Semilab Japan provides specialized measurement systems crucial for wafer metrology and characterization in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Semilab Japan specializes in providing advanced measurement systems for semiconductor wafer characterization. Their products focus on non-destructive techniques to measure and analyze trench shapes, thin films, and electrical properties of silicon and silicon carbide wafers, supporting the power semiconductor and wafer metrology segments.
capabilities: In-line measurement of Si and SiC trench shapes
Measurement of in-plane distribution of mobility and carrier concentration
Sheet resistance measurement for wafers up to 200 mm

regional_presence.Japan: Semilab Japan operates in Japan, focusing on sales and support for its measurement systems in the local semiconductor industry.
